scope: RPG.GameCore.SetDynamicValueByProperty payloads with exactly DynamicKey, ReadTargetType=Caster or SnapshotPropertyEntity, and Value=BreakDamageAddedRatio.
selected_model: Resolve exactly one explicit Caster or SnapshotPropertyEntity and copy its already-materialized RuntimeEntity.break_damage_added_ratio leaf into the selected DynamicValue scope/key. This is a property read only: it does not calculate Break damage, reconstruct property contributions, or capture snapshots.
ordering: The supplied materialized ratio is copied synchronously at this callback sibling. Later values use the normal DynamicValue visibility model; this packet establishes no Break event or snapshot lifecycle timing.

evidence.support: MCommon_Element_Bleed, MCommon_Element_Entangle and MCommon_Element_Confine use Caster/SnapshotPropertyEntity BreakDamageAddedRatio reads.
The existing reconstruction model maps BreakDamageAddedRatioBase to the break-effect stat family without using it to infer this runtime read.
Caster and SnapshotPropertyEntity require explicit deterministic context identities.
A real canonical MCommon_Element_Bleed OnCreate operation executes through the generic compiler/executor.

unsupported_boundary: full Element Bleed lifecycle and Golden trace claim
dsh_implementation_contract: Carry a separately materialized break-damage ratio in battle state and pass it through the exact target alias. Do not substitute the target's toughness break context, calculate a formula, or fallback from a snapshot to the caster. Copy only the selected leaf into DynamicValue; reject all other property reads until explicit contracts exist.
